title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study R)
description: Study R of the bigP3BCI collection, comprising EEG recordings from 20 participants with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) performing a P300-based brain-computer interface speller task. The study used 9x8 character grids with multi-face stimulus paradigms, and each participant completed two sessions. Recordings were made with 32 channels at 256 Hz, and events are annotated as target and non-target stimuli with HED tags. The data are a MOABB/BIDS-formatted derivative of the PhysioNet bigP3BCI dataset.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) using 32 channels at 256 Hz, positioned according to the standard 10-20 montage. Participants performed a visual P300 speller task with a 9x8 grid and multi-face stimuli, with calibration followed by online testing with feedback. Target and non-target events were epoched over a 0-1.0 s interval.
